## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- OAuthCredentialEngine.initial / authorize
- initial state is not-authorized with 0 failures
- authorize sets status=authorized + records expires + last_refreshed
- OAuthCredentialEngine.reevaluate — expiry transitions
- authorized stays authorized when >1h until expiry
- transitions to expiring-soon when ≤1h until expiry
